parse_as_duration_string: parse a Python timedelta object into a Polars duration string format
datetime_to_int: convert a Python datetime object to an integer timestamp in specified time unit
to_py_datetime: convert an integer timestamp with time unit and optional timezone to a Python datetime object
to_py_timedelta: convert an integer or float value with time unit to a Python timedelta object
negate_duration_string: negate a Polars duration string by adding or removing the leading minus sign
